description: Send a brand's request on one Rate of a creator. Piku emails the brand a confirm link; the request reaches the creator's Deals only after the brand confirms, within 48 hours. Needs the creator's handle, the Rate id, the brand's name and contact email, and a short brief, as the user gave them. Returns a request_id.

brief.description: What the brand needs, in a few lines

rate_id.description: The Rate's id from get_rate_card, like ig-reel
